reviews.t: Great Hair Styling Kit with a Few Small Modifications
reviews.x: This is a great kit to use to make a lot of easy styles. The pictures on the instructions are clear but very small.  I found a way around this by looking on the picture here of the instructions and, putting the cursor over it to enlarge the images. Then I had no trouble seeing the pictures.  The items in this kit are high quality, with the only downside being the spirals pins. They are about 3/4 the size of the Goody ones and are somewhat sharp. I fixed this by putting a thick dab of clear nail

LOVE LOVE LOVE this! I've used almost everything and it works wonderfully. Better quality than I expected for the price. The only reason it's getting 4 stars instead of 5 is that the bumpit things (I don't know what they are called) are black and not brown, and a little crooked. They still work well. Bobby pins are better quality than I thought they would be. Th bun things are amazing (I have super long hair so I pretty much only use the big one). I'm learning how to use the other bits from tria
Poor quality pins. The paint is sloppily applied to the pins and  tore my hair. It's great to have a grouping of all these different products that I've been wanting to try, but the quality is poor.

reviews.t: I probably would like it if I knew how to use the items ...
reviews.x: I probably would like it if I knew how to use the items included.  The teeny tiny folded slip of paper with the instructions for use of each item is TOTALLY WORTHLESS.  This leaves me with a box full of things that I don't know how to use.  Some reviewers have suggested looking on line for ideas of how to use the items included in the box.  Limited success here.  I just can't imagine why a nice pamphlet with instructions is not included with these products.  I was hoping to at the least contact
Great selection, difficult directions. It didn't explained how to use all the items, I had to research it on line. Not worth the price. Would tell others to pass

Everything is so hard to use. It took me ages to figure out how to use most of the items, and some of them didn't even work as they supposed to. I thought that maybe I wasn't doing it right, so I watched many tutorials on youtube.It seems a general problem of these kind of products, not with this one in particular. I gave it 3 stars because if I try really hard I can actually make a decent bun with the foam bun maker. I expected to be really easy, but it is too complicated for me.

I purchased this for a photoshoot where I needed to shape six different model's hair into various retro up do's. This set definitely made an otherwise chaotic day run far more smoothly. Victory rolls, bumper bangs, and a Gibson roll later, my models looked stunning and their hair stayed put through a 14 hour shoot!
I have been using this for almost two years! I use most of the things that come in the kit and love them! Not too pricy and easy to use!

reviews.t: Great Set to Use on Your Daughter's Hair
reviews.x: This is a great set to use for dance hair or just cute hair at home.  I've had fun learning how to use the different tools that come in this set and I've watched YouTube videos to do that.  I haven't needed to use the largest bun maker on my girls because they don't have long enough hair for it.  PROS several different tools to make different hairstyles endless number of hairstyles can be made with this set affordable easy to use or easy to learn to use if you watch YouTube videos  CONS very few

reviews.t: Pleasant surprise in quality and usefulness
reviews.x: Everything in this bundle was of greater quality than I expected! We love the hair ties or rubberbands, because they aren't rubber and don't snap or break! Have had this for over a year and am buying another because my daughter and I have lost too many of the Bobby pins and hair ties. The bun makers look and work great. The directions are small and I'll printed, I felt that most of the items were relatively self explanatory or I was already familiar with. However I was able to struggle through t

You do need long hair to get the best deal out of this.  If you do, this is an incredible buy.  I've bought just one of the bun doughnuts for $4 at Wal-mart.  It may take some practice and learning on a few of the items but isn't that the whole point of buying it, to get variety with long hair instead of the same pony tail or throw up bun day after day.  This is a must have for long hair.

Really poor illustrations! I couldn't figure out how to use several pieces of this bunddle. I do like the bun makers and the spiral pins. My hair is shoulder leangth so I'm guessing they would work better with longer hair. Until my hair grows longer I'm not really enjoying this bunddle. They make you think it's gonna do miracles in your hair, but no it doesn't have a lot to it.

reviews.t: I love the fact they have little bit of everything
reviews.x: I love the fact they have little bit of everything, but the quality is somewhat mediocre. The doughnut shape sponge cannot hold hairs well, not working well as the one I got from Forever21, and my hair will not stay in the place. If you have full, thick hair, it won't be a matter, but with thin hair like mine, you can see the sponge as the hair won't stay in the place.

I got this for my daughter.  We were excited to try out the new tools but we couldn't read the instructions.  The pictures were very small and the instructions were confusing and unclear.  If you already know how to use these tools you'd probably be fine.

reviews.t: I wear a bun daily and even discovered new ways to do a good bun with this kit
reviews.x: A lot of items that all work well. Decent quality for plastics and mesh. Well with the money. I wear a bun daily and even discovered new ways to do a good bun with this kit.
Nice kit.  Only thing I would have preferred is better instructions on how to use all the enclosed hair accessories.
Arrived on time and had every single item! Have not tried all the tools but the bun makers are perfect!

First of all, I have fine hair down to my waist, and I was mainly either wearing it down, or in a pony tail. I only got the kit today, and I used the bun roller first. I've never been able to put my hair in a perfect circle, ever! First try with the bun roller, and I had my first ever perfect bun. You really can't beat the price for all the items that you get. Unlike other people I had to use 3 hair pins for my hair, because my hair can be difficult. I like the fact that they can pretty much mat

reviews.t: It's okay. Should have purchased separates instead.
reviews.x: The only items of this kit I use are the plate bun ring makers, the volume hair bases, and the elastic hair bands. I have red hair and bought the brown set. I only notice the hair pieces if I am really looking for them or don't cover them completely (like with the volume bases). I use the elastic bands the most often because they fit snugly without pulling my hair back too tightly and they aren't so loose they fall out. They work really great for making buns. reviews.t: Pretty good bundle for the price!
reviews.x: I was skeptical about ordering this with the mixed reviews with some people saying they got all their items in a plastic bag or no instructions, but for the price and the fact that it came with the foam forms for buns, I figured why not. My item came as a box with instructions and all the items inside! I purchased the brown set and everything is a reddish brown except the spiral pins and and hair bump sponges which are black.  I don't know if I'll use the plastic loops to pull ponytails through

reviews.t: it might be fun to pay a little more than I would if ...
reviews.x: I got this set because I was curious about the spiral thingies and figured, for the price, it might be fun to pay a little more than I would if I was just buying the spirals elsewhere and have some stuff to play around with.  Most of the items turned out to be pretty meh, so now I'm the proud owner of spiral thingies and some clutter.  Pros: The spiral bun holders are great - both for holding my hair up in a neat bun and for putting my hair in before bed. If I wear them to bed (on not totally dr

The instructions are written by a non-native speaker: for example to explain how to use the Magic Hair Twist Styling Braid Tool Care Clip: 1. put braid into curler and then roll up you hairs. 2. roll up your braid, until all of the hair be on the twist curler clamp. 3. hook the two hooks, then finished. Some, not all of the items have illustrations to show how to use them. Most of the pictures are either too blurry, or are simple line drawings that I cannot understand what they are trying to sho

When I received this I realized it was for black hair.  I have auburn hair so would have selected brunette if given the option.  I didn't see anything in the description that indicated it was for black hair, but then again I could have just missed it.  With that being said, I like the assortment of hair toys.  The different bun sizes are great and so are the twisty bobby pins to keep the hair in place.  I would recommend, just pay attention to the selected color.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the instructions unclear or inadequate, making the items hard to figure out without outside help.
Reviewers praise the variety and selection of items in the kit.
Several reviewers report poor quality on some items, such as pins and doughnut sponges.
Some reviewers say the products work well and hold hair in place, especially for long or fine hair.
A few reviewers note the kit works better with longer hair.
